INTERNATIONAL CRIMINAL COURT & SPECIAL COUNTER-TERROR TRIBUNAL.
Prosecution Case Ref: ICC-2024-EXCHANGE-LY-099: Prosecutor v. Adheem Barakat & Ors.

1. Person Adheem Barakat [ID:P601] is named as Prime Accused and head of the Libyan militant hostage syndicate in this case.
2. Person Adheem Barakat [ID:P601] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-BARAKAT-LIBYA-VAULT].
3. Person Adheem Barakat [ID:P601] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-SAHARA-EXTORTION-POOL].
4. Person Noura [ID:P602] is named as Co-Accused and extortion negotiator in this case.
5. Person Noura [ID:P602] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-MED-OFFSHORE-MALTA].
6. Person Omar Celik [ID:P603] is named as Co-Accused and Lannak Construction CEO in this case.
7. Person Omar Celik [ID:P603] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-LANNAK-ISTANBUL-01].
8. Person Adam Celik [ID:P608] is named as Co-Accused and Geneva financial controller in this case.
9. Person Adam Celik [ID:P608] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-CELIK-GENEVA-ESCROW].
10. Person Samir [ID:P609] is named as Co-Accused and tactical desert convoy coordinator in this case.
11. Person Samir [ID:P609] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-SAMIR-DESERT-POOL].
12. Person Mitchell Y McDeere [ID:P604] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-SCULLY-TRUST-NYC] and is referenced in this case as a witness and designated ransom courier.
13. Person Giovanna Sandroni [ID:P605] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-SANDRONI-ROME] and is referenced in this case as an abducted associate attorney and primary victim.
14. Person Abby McDeere [ID:P606] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-MCDEERE-NYC] and is referenced in this case as a witness.
15. Person Luca Sandroni [ID:P607] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-SANDRONI-SENIOR] and is referenced in this case as a witness.
16. Accused Adheem Barakat [ID:P601] demanded $100,000,000 USD ransom following the Great Gaddafi Bridge ambush, routing funds from Lannak Construction and Geneva escrow through Malta into Sahara Pool and Barakat Libya Vault.
